name: Kamishina Aoi
source:
[b]Headstrong, high-energy otaku gyaru[/b]

An otaku-type girl who mainly focuses on cosplay.
When it comes to things she finds cute, she charges in headfirst—whether it's a guy, a girl, an animal, a non-human creature, or even an inanimate object, it doesn't matter. If she thinks it's cute, she's all in.

After hearing that the fashion design club might be disbanded, she really wants to support her friend Himari. However, since they’ve grown distant lately, she hasn’t been able to find the right moment to reach out.

She’s a hardcore otaku and absolutely loves cute things.
When she gets too excited, she often loses sight of everything around her. Lately, she’s been totally obsessed with the “kind gyaru who’s nice to otaku” archetype.


•Her birthday it's the same day as the "Cosplay Day"
•She is good at: Cosplay, gaming (in general).
•She is bad at: Sports, cooking, holding back.

[i]"A gyaru who's kind to otakus? Honestly, that's just irresistible!"[/i]
